question: Should the Wave 2+ dashboard roadmap proceed as bundled Control UI/plugin work, and which child items should move to external plugin, skill, or ClawHub surfaces?
rationale: The roadmap is aligned with web-frontend ergonomics but crosses default bundled plugin, browser sandbox, persistent state, command binding, and skill-distribution boundaries that automation cannot choose for maintainers.

options.title: Sponsor staged dashboard work
options.body: Keep the tracker open, review linked subissues and PRs in dependency order, and require explicit storage, security, and dependency approval before any bundled default surface lands.

options.title: Narrow to extension APIs
options.body: Keep only missing plugin/widget SDK seams in OpenClaw and ask optional widgets, skills, and app bundles to prove themselves through ClawHub or external plugin packages first.

options.title: Pause the roadmap
options.body: Defer the linked PR stack and close or postpone the roadmap if maintainers do not want bundled dashboard work in the current product cycle.

recommendation.title: Sponsor staged dashboard work
recommendation.body: Keep the tracker open, review linked subissues and PRs in dependency order, and require explicit storage, security, and dependency approval before any bundled default surface lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal is the recently merged plugin-tab seam and Logbook precedent that the dashboard stack builds on.
